notes.title: Dezatopia v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Balances Changes
・Changed bonus calculation when clearing the game.
・Changed how points are displayed in hidden mode.
・Added some hidden mode score records.
・Adjust particle emission a little for performance.

Bug Fixes
・Fixed score when destroying Inome.
・Fixed a bug where the speed of your ship slowed at the start of the stage.
・Fixed Harady's double KO bug.
・Fixed some score recording bugs.

notes.title: Dezatopia v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Everyone, thank you so much for all the support during release and hope everyone is enjoying the game! We've been listening to a lot of reports and have updated the game to 1.0.1! If there's there's still any more pressing issues please let us know!

Balance Changes
・Adjust bottom shot power
・Change pattern for Reneo Mole Boss
・Adjust Boss HP
・Change pattern for Seihoko enemy
・Slightly weaken Leonardo Boss

Bug Fixes
・Fix bullets disappearing during Momoko rematch 
・Fix replay recording in route J
・Fix Haradi Double KO Bug
・Fix Haradi black screen bug
・Fix various English typos (individuallる is not a word)
・Fix ending illustrations
・Fix a bug with upper and lower walls in Kaldelala rematch
・Fix occasional crash when exiting the game
・Fix an issue where some users with fullwidth Japanese names are unable to save

Experimental Features
・Windows: It is possible to use a DirectX backend by passing a --directx parameter. It is still pretty buggy, only enable if you are having significant graphical issues and cannot get the game to run.
